summary: Premise is false: FUNCTIONFIELD_ES.md §5 Thm 5.3 gives a failure proportion <= (Phi(A)+o(1))/log n, i.e. ~1/log n via Chebyshev on one prime-g family; q^{-n/10} is only the error term in the second moment (line ~218). Remark (3) says RH(Weil) only replaces Bombieri-Vinogradov, and Remark (2) says the same proof works over Z, so there is no FF power-saving gap. Literature: Pomerance arXiv:2511.16817 (ES-Schinzel exceptions) gives the Vaughan-type bound N/exp(C(log^2 N/phi(m))^{1/3}) and no GRH-conditional power saving appears in its full text (grep for GRH/Riemann: none).
not_done: A search for an independent GRH-conditional ES exceptional-set paper beyond arXiv:2511.16817 and the search-engine hits; no proof attempt for a GRH power saving.
next: Drop the power-saving framing; if pursued, ask whether GRH (not RH) gives a power saving in the Vaughan sieve over Z.
